_comment: SMAC-style tech tree structure (owner directive 2026-07-27, researched against Sid Meier's Alpha Centauri: categories form an INTERTWINING tree; every tech has AT MOST TWO prerequisites; tiers flow foundations -> frontier; blind research means the far tree is fog). Three branches for now (owner: 'just 3 pages for the moment'). RULES: roots are the FINITE set of already-built capabilities — curated at the CAPABILITY level, deliberately not a per-RB retrofit; techs reference either a backlog row (ref: RB-*, state read LIVE from RESEARCH_BACKLOG's state column — that file stays the single state source for RB items) or are curated near-frontier items (allowed state: available only; completion later lands in the ledger/backlog and promotes the node). Every tech's prereqs list existing root/tech ids and is capped at 2, per SMAC; edges are design statements about what COMBINES into what. Colors validated 2026-07-27 with the dataviz palette validator on the dark surface (all four checks pass; gold-green tritan dE 9.9 sits in the legal-with-secondary-encoding band, and every node carries its branch icon + text label, never color alone).
